releases.name: v0.8.0
releases.body:
## Install

Download the file for your system below and follow the Install section of the
[README](https://github.com/JorisJonkers-dev/rauls-trusty-toolbox#install). To check a download, put it next to
`SHA256SUMS` and run `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing` (Linux; macOS: `shasum -a 256 <file>`, Windows
PowerShell: `Get-FileHash <file>`, then compare with the line of that file).

## [0.8.0](https://github.com/JorisJonkers-dev/rauls-trusty-toolbox/compare/v0.7.0...v0.8.0) (2026-11-25)


### Features

* **lod:** ask lodwright for far models of objects no plugin marks visible from far ([#630](https://github.com/JorisJonkers-dev/rauls-trusty-toolbox/issues/630)) ([4e93b89](https://github.com/JorisJonkers-dev/rauls-trusty-toolbox/commit/4e93b8916b3338e1e96b50bdc5e723a114b0eff7))

## Contents

Every installer holds raul with the linked Components built in (ADR-0016) and the engine (nv-rs) too.
No separate engine program is included; the game starts as raul's own play mode.
Nothing of ours is downloaded on first run.

| Part | Version | How it is in the installer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| nvmod-rs | v0.19.0 | linked into raul |
| nv-rs | v0.26.0 | linked into raul |
| loot-rs | v0.10.0 | linked into raul |
| lodwright-rs | v0.19.0 | linked into raul |
| ttwright-rs | v0.5.0 | linked into raul |

## Signing

- Windows: **unsigned**. SmartScreen may warn; choose More info, Run anyway.
- macOS: **unsigned**: macOS will ask you to allow it in System Settings, Privacy & Security.
- Linux: AppImage, .deb and .tar.gz are not signed; verify with SHA256SUMS and `gh attestation verify <file> --repo JorisJonkers-dev/rauls-trusty-toolbox`.

Source of every GPL Component at these versions: see the submodules (components/) at v0.8.0.
You need your own copy of Fallout: New Vegas; no game files are included.
